reason: I already had to raise my prices twice this year, so another 25 € a month going to something I saw scrolling is a no. I change the specials on the chalkboard and my Instagram, and that works for me.
objection: I don't know who is behind this. If the AI puts a wrong price on Google or the thing breaks, who do I call? And I don't want to learn a new app.
would_change_my_mind: Another café owner I know telling me they've used it for a few months, that it really is just sending a WhatsApp message, and that it brought them customers from Google.
